description: Columbus, MS — In case you missed it, District Attorney Scott Colom joined Jon Favreau on Pod Save America, one of the most popular political podcasts in the country, for a wide-ranging conversation about why a seventh-generation Mississippian and three-term prosecutor is running for Senate, the case against Cindy Hyde-Smith, and why this race is more competitive than some national political observers assume.
